mapper.sql: id, project_id, task_id, task_run_id, review_snapshot_id, review_decision_id, operator_id, project_name, task_title, repository_path, ticket, commit_message, branch_name, base_ref, commit_sha, file_paths_json, status, failure_reason, output_summary, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM git_commit_record WHERE review_snapshot_id = #{snapshotId} AND status = 'SUCCEEDED' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM git_commit_record WHERE review_snapshot_id = #{snapshotId} AND status = 'RUNNING' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO git_commit_record ( project_id, task_id, task_run_id, review_snapshot_id, review_decision_id, operator_id, project_name, task_title, repository_path, ticket, commit_message, branch_name, base_ref, commit_sha, file_paths_json, status, failure_reason, output_summary, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{projectId}, #{taskId}, #{taskRunId}, #{reviewSnapshotId}, #{reviewDecisionId}, #{operatorId}, #{projectName}, #{taskTitle}, #{repositoryPath}, #{ticket}, #{commitMessage}, #{branchName}, #{baseRef}, #{commitSha}, CAST(#{filePathsJson} AS JSON), #{status}, #{failureReason}, #{outputSummary}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE git_commit_record SET branch_name = #{branchName}, commit_sha = #{commitSha}, status = #{status}, failure_reason = #{failureReason}, output_summary = #{outputSummary}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
